summary: Removed the `detect` and `detectRoots` methods from the `GizmoServerExtension` contract and migrated Unity and Svelte extensions to a config-only shape. Rewrote the Svelte extension to use `id`, `name`, `profile`, `systemPrompt`, and `createTools`, and adjusted `FakeAgentClient.detectProject` accordingly. App tests revealed a Select-based "Profile being edited" menu that requires pointerDown to open, prompting a switch from click to pointerDown in the new test.
decisions: `detect` and `detectRoots` are no longer part of the extension contract; detection is no longer provided by extensions (reasons not stated in this segment).

Svelte extension is rewritten as a minimal `GizmoServerExtension` with an empty `createTools` array and a system prompt that respects the project's Svelte version/conventions and does not assume SvelteKit unless its packages/config are present.
Unity's `detect` (ProjectSettings check) and helper `exists` are removed; `unityDomain` no longer implements a detect function.
Tests must use `fireEvent.pointerDown` (button 0) rather than `click` to open the Select-based "Profile being edited" menu.
errors: App test failed at App.test.ts:738 because `fireEvent.click` on the "Profile being edited" button did not open the Select menu; resolved by switching the interaction to `fireEvent.pointerDown` with button 0.
